name: LocalAI
summary: MIT self-hosted OpenAI-compatible engine that runs LLM, vision, voice and image backends locally, with Docker images as the documented install.
description: Established open project (canonical repo mudler/LocalAI; not archived; created 2023-03-18; last pushed 2026-11-14; not presented as a 2026 launch). github.com/go-skynet/LocalAI 301s to mudler/LocalAI and is not used as a URL, repo or source. Root LICENSE is MIT (Copyright (c) 2023-2025 Ettore Di Giacinto (mudler@localai.io)). Site https://localai.io/ and docs https://localai.io/docs/ were HTTP 200; https://localai.io/docs 301s to the trailing-slash URL and is not used. GitHub latest release v4.12.1 was published 2026-10-23T10:27:00Z = 2026-10-23 11:27:00 Europe/Stockholm (not draft/prerelease). PyPI project localai 0.0.26 is a different package (vietanhdev/pautobot, “Private AutoGPT Robot”) and is not the official install path; do not pip install localai for this project. README documented install is Docker (for example docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 localai/localai:latest, plus GPU-tagged images). Those commands were not executed. README: a small core pulls backends (llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, whisper.cpp, MLX and others are named) as OCI images when a model needs them. A built-in agent can read files and run commands on the host, asking for approval before changes — treat that agent as potentially destructive. Add-ons (Studio, Talk, Voice, Face, Simple Office, Sandbox and more) install from a signed catalog. macOS DMG is documented as not signed by Apple (quarantine xattr note in the README). Model weights and any GPU or host resources are licensed and billed separately.

agent_access.notes: Open-source self-hosted engine. Documented install is Docker images such as localai/localai:latest, not PyPI localai (that name is a different project). GitHub latest is v4.12.1. No containers were started. The built-in agent can run host commands.
